tasks.subject: Task 5: ScannerScreen: viewfinder, shutter, result and failure sheets
tasks.description:
**Files:** see plan Layout
**Goal:** Replace the placeholder (handoff 14, 16, 17). Dark `Scaffold` (`colors.viewfinderBg`), `Stack` of `_Viewfinder` (mono caption « [ FLUX CAMÉRA ] », `AspectRatio(64/88)` frame with four `_Bracket` corners via `CustomPaint` in `colors.viewfinderBracket`, « Cadrez une tuile », `_Shutter` disc disabled while analysing) and a `Positioned` + `AnimatedSlide` sheet layer (pattern `lesson_screen.dart:278-300`): `_ResultSheet` (drag handle, `TileWidget(size: .demo)`, `tileName` headlineSmall, mono uppercase subtitle with « AKA DORA · » prefix when red, CTA « Scanner une autre tuile ») and `_FailureSheet` (grey « ? » box, « Tuile non reconnue », « RIEN D'IDENTIFIÉ », tips line, « Réessayer »). Promote the lesson screen's `_PrimaryButton` to `lib/shared/widgets/primary_button_widget.dart` (`PrimaryButtonWidget`). Tokens: bracketStroke, bracketArm, shutterSize, shutterRing, sheetHandleWidth, sheetHandleHeight.
**Acceptance Criteria:** emulator: shutter opens the system camera; photo → result or failure sheet slides up; « Scanner une autre tuile » / « Réessayer » reopen the camera; cancel → viewfinder; screenshots vs 14, 16, 17 light + dark
**Verify:** flutter analyze && dart run tool/check_conventions.dart, then visual
